scope: Every file distributed under public/atlas except this manifest itself must match exactly one group pattern.

groups.modifications: Grid selection or resampling, 8-bit conversion, compression, background masking, validation metadata and display tone mapping.
groups.displayObligation: Credit BigBrain and Amunts et al.; link the license; identify modifications; retain non-commercial and share-alike terms; imply no endorsement.

groups.source: BigBrain co-registration/manual subcortical segmentation, Xiao et al.
groups.license: CC BY 4.0 for the co-registration labels; underlying BigBrain terms remain applicable where BigBrain material is present
groups.modifications: Label-number conversion, storage on the exact 0.5 mm ICBM500 grid, compression, and 1 mm display-mesh extraction.
groups.displayObligation: Credit Xiao and collaborators; link CC BY 4.0; retain the separate BigBrain notice and do not imply expert validation.

groups.source: Combined exact-grid teaching labels: Xiao manual labels, CerebrA-derived provisional masks, project-authored image-guided candidates, and reviewed image-guided mammillary bodies
groups.license: Mixed by label source; distributed with the non-commercial BigBrain teaching package
groups.modifications: Merge into unused label IDs, apply approved exact-grid segmentation patches, validate and compress, and record provenance and confidence metadata.
groups.displayObligation: Show manual, atlas-provisional, image-guided candidate and image-guided reviewed status separately; retain all BigBrain, Xiao, MNI and project notices; never describe the combined file as anatomical ground truth.

groups.source: MNI152NLin2009cSym, CerebrA and MNI152 high-density white surfaces via TemplateFlow/BigBrainWarp
groups.modifications: 1 mm browser volume, label lookup, pial-like normal expansion, sulcal shading, volumetric mesh extraction, surface-region sampling, provisional exact-grid mesh extraction, and deterministic lossless gzip sidecars for the two pial meshes.
groups.displayObligation: Retain the MNI copyright notice in every copy; identify CerebrA and derived/provisional transformations; do not imply endorsement or validated morphometry.

groups.source: Mixed per-file sources recorded in specimen-blocks.json: BigBrain-derived tissue, manual labels, provisional same-grid labels, and project-authored schematic parts
groups.license: Per sourceType; the distributed specimen package retains CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for BigBrain derivatives and project teaching parts, CC BY 4.0 attribution for Xiao labels, and MNI terms where applicable
groups.modifications: BigBrain tissue reduced to 1 mm geometry with shade values; labelled and schematic structures separated into detachable parts.
groups.displayObligation: Use each file's sourceType; show specimen-derived, manual/provisional segmentation and schematic parts separately; retain non-commercial teaching-package notice and no-ground-truth disclaimer.

groups.source: Brain Practical Navigator contributors; manually placed or procedurally generated teaching paths and shapes
groups.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for generated teaching data; generator source is AGPL-3.0-or-later
groups.modifications: Projection to the application display space and conversion into lightweight WebGL meshes with selectable IDs where applicable.
groups.displayObligation: Identify as schematic or position guide; state major omissions; prohibit clinical or quantitative interpretation; imply no validation or endorsement.

groups.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the project-authored teaching mesh; generator source is AGPL-3.0-or-later
groups.modifications: Deterministic low-resolution schematic tube geometry authored for an opt-in contributor comparison prototype; no specimen or atlas vertices are sampled.
groups.displayObligation: Keep contributor-only scope; label as schematic and expert-unreviewed; state that it is not specimen-derived, not an anatomical ground-truth segmentation, and not a learner-facing replacement.

groups.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for project-authored educational audit metadata
groups.modifications: Project-maintained machine-readable index of lecture coverage, learner surfaces, provenance states, quiz eligibility and known limitations; it does not alter the underlying atlas assets.
groups.displayObligation: Retain the distinction between source data, provisional teaching representations, project review and expert review; do not describe the registry as anatomical ground truth or institutional approval.

groups.source: License, attribution and disclosure texts accompanying the distributed data
groups.license: Informational notices; underlying terms are named in each file
groups.displayObligation: Ship these notices unchanged with every copy of the corresponding browser assets.
